Our story

A quiet beginning

What began as a single conversation grew into a bond we pray Allah will bless. With the duas and blessings of our families, we invite you to witness our nikah and to celebrate it beside us, in sha Allah.

The details

Everything for the day

Beyond the three main moments, here is how the rest of the day will unfold.

  1. 3:30 PM

    Guests arrive

    Gates open. Welcome drinks and seating in the garden.

  2. 4:45 PM

  3. At sunset

    We pause together for the sunset prayer before the feast.
